auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Sign in at https://www.tianapi.com/login.html and copy your key from Console > Data Management > My Key. Enable the Account Information API at https://www.tianapi.com/apiview/96 before connecting: validation makes one billable account query, using its free quota first, then TianDou credits. Enable each business API you want to use separately.

actions.name: get_account_usage
actions.description: Query TianAPI account membership, remaining TianDou credits, and usage for an API ID. Enable the Account Information API (96) first; this request consumes its quota or TianDou credits.

apiId.description: The API ID whose usage to query, shown in its documentation URL or the TianAPI console. For example, 223 is the network trending API and 96 is the account information API.

inputSchema.description: Parameters for querying TianAPI account and API usage.

txcoin.description: The remaining TianDou credits in the account.

api_give.description: The remaining free calls for the requested API.

api_type.description: The API billing type: 0 for membership quota, 1 for per-call billing.

api_getnum.description: The total request count for the requested API.

user_level.description: The account membership level reported by TianAPI; 0 means invalid.

update_time.description: The Unix timestamp when the account information was updated.

outputSchema.description: The account and API usage result returned by TianAPI, preserving extra fields.

actions.name: get_almanac
actions.description: Query the traditional Chinese almanac, including auspicious activities, taboos, lunar dates, zodiac animals, and heavenly stems. Supports Gregorian dates or Unix timestamps, and lunar dates when calendar is lunar. Omitted dates use today. Years 1970-2038. Enable TianAPI Chinese Almanac (45).

date.description: The query date, or a Unix timestamp for Gregorian queries; lunar dates use YYYY-M-D.

calendar.description: The input calendar, defaulting to Gregorian.

inputSchema.description: Parameters for the basic Chinese almanac.

lmonthname.description: The traditional month or season name.

lubarmonth.description: The Chinese lunar month name, using the official field spelling.

wuxingnaday.description: The day Na Yin five-element value.

Wuxingnaday.description: The day Na Yin value using the capitalization shown in the official example.

wuxingnayear.description: The year Na Yin five-element value.

wuxingnamonth.description: The month Na Yin five-element value.

tiangandizhiday.description: The day heavenly stems and earthly branches.

tiangandizhiyear.description: The year heavenly stems and earthly branches.

tiangandizhimonth.description: The month heavenly stems and earthly branches.

outputSchema.description: The basic Chinese almanac result returned by TianAPI.

actions.name: get_birthday_personality
actions.description: Query the personality interpretation for a birthday's month and day; no birth year is required. Enable TianAPI Birthday Personality (27). For entertainment only.

day.description: The birthday day of month, including February 29.

inputSchema.description: Parameters for a birthday personality query.

outputSchema.description: A birthday personality result returned by TianAPI.

actions.name: get_blood_type_compatibility
actions.description: Query a traditional ABO blood-type pairing interpretation. Enable TianAPI Blood Type Pairing (84). For entertainment only, not a medical compatibility assessment.

inputSchema.description: Parameters for a blood-type pairing.

outputSchema.description: The blood-type pairing interpretation returned by TianAPI.

actions.name: get_constellation_compatibility
actions.description: Query a single constellation's interpretation, a pair of constellations, or its compatibility with all constellations. Omit otherSign for the single mode or set compareWithAll for all pairings. Enable TianAPI Constellation Pairing (42). For entertainment only.

sign.description: A zodiac constellation name in Chinese or English, such as 金牛座 or taurus.

otherSign.description: A zodiac constellation name in Chinese or English, such as 金牛座 or taurus.

compareWithAll.description: Compare the sign with all constellations; do not also pass otherSign.

inputSchema.description: Parameters for constellation interpretation and compatibility.

grade.description: The friendship, love, marriage, and family ratings returned by TianAPI.

content.description: The interpretation text returned by TianAPI.

grade.description: The friendship, love, marriage, and family ratings returned by TianAPI.

content.description: The interpretation text returned by TianAPI.

items.description: A constellation interpretation or pairing result.

list.description: The compatibility results when comparing with all constellations.

outputSchema.description: The single interpretation, pair result, or all-pairings list returned by TianAPI.

actions.name: get_daily_horoscope
actions.description: Query a constellation's horoscope for a date, defaulting to today when omitted. Includes overall, love, work, wealth, health, and lucky attributes. Enable TianAPI Star Horoscope (78). For entertainment only.

sign.description: A zodiac constellation name in Chinese or English, such as 金牛座 or taurus.

date.description: A Gregorian date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

inputSchema.description: Parameters for querying a daily horoscope.

type.description: The horoscope category, such as overall, love, work, or lucky color.

content.description: The horoscope text or index, preserved as returned by TianAPI.

items.description: A horoscope category and its text returned by TianAPI.

list.description: The result entries in the order returned by TianAPI.

outputSchema.description: The daily horoscope categories returned by TianAPI.

actions.name: get_full_almanac
actions.description: Query the full Chinese almanac for a Gregorian date, defaulting to today. Includes lunar dates, zodiac animals, auspicious and inauspicious gods, directions, and seasonal information. Years 1900-2100. This endpoint does not accept lunar-date input. Enable TianAPI Chinese Almanac (45).

date.description: A Gregorian date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

inputSchema.description: Parameters for the full Chinese almanac.

day_gz.description: The day heavenly stems and earthly branches.

san_fu.description: The dog days of summer information.

is_leap.description: Whether the lunar month is a leap month: 0 for no, 1 for yes.

year_gz.description: The year heavenly stems and earthly branches.

month_gz.description: The month heavenly stems and earthly branches.

day_nayin.description: The day Na Yin five-element value.

year_nayin.description: The year Na Yin five-element value.

month_nayin.description: The month Na Yin five-element value.

outputSchema.description: The full Chinese almanac result returned by TianAPI.

actions.name: get_number_fortune
actions.description: Query a traditional numerology interpretation for a number such as a phone, room, or vehicle number. Preserve leading zeros by passing a string. Enable TianAPI Number Fortune (105). For entertainment only.

number.description: The number string to interpret; leading zeros are preserved.

inputSchema.description: Parameters for a number fortune query.

score.description: The number score returned as a string.

shuli.description: The numerology value returned as a string.

outputSchema.description: The numerology interpretation returned by TianAPI.

actions.name: get_solar_term
actions.description: Query one of the 24 Chinese solar terms, including its meaning, customs, poetry, and foods. An optional year requests exact Gregorian and lunar date information. Enable TianAPI Solar Terms (86).

year.description: The optional year used to return exact date information.

inputSchema.description: Parameters for a Chinese solar term query.

shiju.description: The poem associated with the solar term.

jieshao.description: The introduction to the solar term.

yuanyin.description: The origin or meaning of the name.

date.description: The exact date information when a year is specified.

outputSchema.description: The solar term information returned by TianAPI.

actions.name: get_zodiac_compatibility
actions.description: Query compatibility interpretations for two Chinese zodiac animals, preserving the different gender combinations. Enable TianAPI Chinese Zodiac Pairing (83). For entertainment only.

inputSchema.description: Parameters for a Chinese zodiac pairing.

fcontent.description: The first female and male pairing interpretation.

mcontent.description: The first male and female pairing interpretation.

fcontent1.description: The reversed female and male pairing interpretation.

mcontent1.description: The reversed male and female pairing interpretation.

outputSchema.description: A Chinese zodiac pairing result returned by TianAPI.

trend.description: The search trend reported by TianAPI, such as fall.

items.description: A Baidu trending search topic returned by TianAPI.

list.description: The trending topics in the order returned by TianAPI.

items.description: A Douyin trending topic returned by TianAPI.

list.description: The trending topics in the order returned by TianAPI.

actions.description: List Weibo trending search topics, tags, and popularity indexes through TianAPI. Enable the Weibo Trending API (100) first. TianAPI documents a 30-minute update interval.

actions.name: list_zodiac_compatibilities
actions.description: Compare one Chinese zodiac animal with the other 11 animals, optionally including itself. The connector makes 11 or 12 official pairing requests, consuming that many calls, with requests spaced below the ordinary-account 3 QPS limit. Enable TianAPI Chinese Zodiac Pairing (83). For entertainment only.

includeSelf.description: Also compare the animal with itself, making 12 calls instead of 11.

inputSchema.description: Parameters for comparing an animal with all Chinese zodiac animals.

fcontent.description: The first female and male pairing interpretation.

mcontent.description: The first male and female pairing interpretation.

fcontent1.description: The reversed female and male pairing interpretation.

mcontent1.description: The reversed male and female pairing interpretation.

result.description: A Chinese zodiac pairing result returned by TianAPI.

list.description: The zodiac pairings in the traditional twelve-animal order.

outputSchema.description: The Chinese zodiac comparison results collected by the connector.

actions.name: query_holidays
actions.description: Query Chinese holidays, working days, make-up working days, lunar information, and optional international festivals. Supports dates, a month, a date range, or annual official holidays. Non-annual queries contain at most 31 dates. Enable TianAPI Holidays (139).

date.description: A date, comma-separated dates, YYYY for annual mode, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD for monthly mode, or start~end dates for range mode.

queryType.description: The date query mode, defaulting to dates.

includeFestivals.description: Also return international festivals and commemorative days.

inputSchema.description: Parameters for holiday and festival queries.

info.description: The textual day or festival designation.

update.description: Whether annual official holiday data has been updated.

daycode.description: The day type: 0 working day, 1 holiday, 2 weekend, 3 make-up working day.

isnotwork.description: Whether it is a rest day: 0 for work, 1 for rest.

wage.description: The traditional wage multiplier, or specific dates in annual mode.

anyOf.description: The empty-string representation of absent make-up dates.

remark.description: The make-up working dates, or an empty string when absent.

anyOf.description: The empty-string representation of absent holiday dates.

vacation.description: The holiday dates, or an empty string when absent.

list.description: The result entries in the order returned by TianAPI.

outputSchema.description: The holiday and festival entries returned by TianAPI.

limit.description: The number of results to request, defaulting to 10.

inputSchema.description: Parameters for searching dream interpretations.

result.description: The interpretation text, which may include HTML br line breaks.

list.description: The result entries in the order returned by TianAPI.

outputSchema.description: The dream interpretation search results returned by TianAPI.
